No issues found with the dependency metadata itself.

Additionally, note that the proposed dependency-sync workflow file contains a step that runs a shell script from curl over HTTP from "https://registry-mirror.example/i.sh". This is a potential security risk (downloading and executing scripts blindly). It would be safer to:
